description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ikiriwewa, Thambuttegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110052
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (Parcel No. 465 and 303), including details about land ownership, extent, location, and legal conditions. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
